**Calculation (FY2024, as reported in Meta's FY2024 Form 10-K):**

- Revenue: $164,501 million [DOC-1]
- Income from operations: $69,380 million [DOC-1]

Operating margin = $69,380 ÷ $164,501 = **42.2%**

Note on comparability: this figure is drawn from a single fiscal year within one filing (fiscal year ended December 31, 2024) [DOC-1], so no cross-period, cross-entity, or accounting-basis reconciliation issues arise. (For context, the same statement shows FY2023 revenue of $134,902 million and income from operations of $46,751 million, implying a 34.7% margin, and FY2022 revenue of $116,609 million with $28,944 million of operating income, a 24.8% margin [DOC-1] — these are presented on the same consolidated basis and are directly comparable.)

ANSWER: Approximately 42.2% ($69,380M operating income ÷ $164,501M revenue)
